page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is a high-frequency compute instance built on the x86_64 architecture and virtualized using KVM. The hardware configuration features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with 20 physical cores and 40 vCPUs running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. Memory is provisioned at 192.0 GB, yielding 4.8 GB of system memory per physical core. The CPU cache layout includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Supported instruction sets include AVX, AVX-512 with VNNI extensions, AES cryptography, BMI2, ADX, and FMA.

The instance does not include local disk storage or discrete GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for persistent data. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 12 Gbps. Performance benchmarks place the server in the middle 50% tier across standard evaluation suites. Measured metrics include a stress-ng multi-core CPU result of 38,378.07, a Geekbench multi-core score of 12,045.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 34,691.95. Uncached memory bandwidth tests recorded 108.89 GB/sec for read operations and 48.09 GB/sec for write operations on large blocks.

Workload testing demonstrates application-level capabilities, including a Redis throughput of 34.78 million SET operations per second and a static web serving rate of 25.35 GB/sec. Small language model inference tests yielded 12.71 tokens per second for text generation using a 7B model. Given its dedicated core allocation and clock speed, the server is structured for CPU-bound tasks such as software compilation, relational database processing, web traffic handling, and general enterprise computing.
